evidence: SyntheticBenchmarkController owns deterministic synthetic suite generation, immutable review, and reports; execution and promotion remain external.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep execution and promotion outside synthetic benchmark storage.

evidence: Synthetic tables do not reference tasks, replay cases, memories, skills, or providers; generation consumes only a closed request.
dimensions.recommendation: Link real evidence by bounded reference without copying historical content.

evidence: Versioned request and review schemas, template substitution, closed difficulty values, three review dimensions, service methods, and four CLI commands are explicit.
dimensions.recommendation: Version the schema before adding generator or review dimensions.

evidence: Schema v71 owns synthetic suites, cases, and reviews in dedicated immutable tables; task and replay stores remain untouched.
dimensions.recommendation: Never backfill synthetic rows into historical task tables.

evidence: Tests cover deterministic generation, diversity, review gates, real evidence, secrets, idempotency, immutability, Safe Mode, CLI, migration, and rollback.
dimensions.recommendation: Add held-out real correlation tests before claiming predictive utility.

evidence: Human review and real-task references are caller-authored claims; templates can still encode biased, trivial, or contaminated tasks.
impact_path: A caller supplies benchmark-adjacent templates or superficial criteria.
A reviewer records unsupported passing assessments and a real-task reference.
An operator could overestimate a candidate if synthetic results are treated as production evidence.
dimensions.recommendation: Require independently measured real-task outcomes for every optimization decision.

evidence: Generation is deterministic template substitution and hashing with no Ollama, cloud, evaluator, network, or provider dependency.
dimensions.recommendation: Put future model-assisted generation behind a separately versioned reviewed adapter.

evidence: Generator, request, suite, case, objective, and evaluation hashes preserve exact v1 lineage.
dimensions.recommendation: Create new immutable suites under future generator versions.

abstractions.purpose: Generate diverse synthetic-only cases and retain explicit review without touching real task history.
use_evidence: Used by AdaptiveRuntime and four benchmark CLI commands over schema v71.
complexity_cost: One module, three immutable tables, migration 71, service methods, CLI commands, documentation, and focused tests.
abstractions.recommendation: Retain while synthetic generation and review remain required.
